repository_context.notes: This spec references empirical receipts in qpi-validator/results/ but does not modify them.

truth_policy.validated_receipts_only: Any claim marked as 'validated' must point to a verifiable receipt (hash, file path, run id, or reproducible command).
models_vs_facts: Statements under 'models' are OS-internal hypotheses/metaphors and are not asserted as external scientific fact.
Statements under 'validated' are only what the receipts directly support.

non_goals: This spec does not claim to solve entropy, physics, or cryptography in the real world without external peer-reviewed evidence.
This spec does not claim compression beyond information-theoretic limits.

runtime_observation_github_actions.environment: GitHub-hosted ubuntu runner (as used by primesieve receipts workflow)

uqhd_concept.one_sentence: Treat each verified anchor as an addressable checkpoint in an append-only ledger that can be used to validate streams, not magically compress them.
why_this_is_useful: Anchors can provide integrity, provenance, and auditability (like a Merkle-backed log).
Anchors can be used as deterministic indices for chunking, sharding, and content-addressing.
what_this_is_not: Not a claim that primes let you store 'more information' than the bits you physically write.

twin_prime_anchor.definition: An anchor keyed by an index i and a twin-prime pair (p, p+2) discovered/verified within a declared bound N.

angle_clock_anchor.definition: An anchor keyed by a discrete angular tick (e.g., 6° increments) that can be used to schedule or gate transitions in an algorithm.

interpretation: This is a design knob: how many bits you assign to each anchor for indexing/commitment.
Example: 256-bit anchors map cleanly to SHA-256 sized commitments.

ledger.rule: All empirical artifacts live in results/ and are covered by results/checksums.txt.
constraints: If a receipt is regenerated, it must be added as a new receipt with its own hash coverage.

merkle_root_optional.purpose: Allow a single commitment to a set of receipts or chunks.
merkle_root_optional.note: Not currently implemented in qpi-validator; proposed extension.

phase_0.goal: Define an anchor schema and a Merkle commitment schema without changing existing results/ rules.
deliverables: scripts/uqhd_build_merkle.py (build merkle root from listed receipts/chunks)

phase_1.goal: Generate anchors from existing receipts, without claiming extra compression.
phase_1.note: Derived artifacts must still be empirical outputs of a deterministic script with a pinned input set.

receipts_needed.name: uqhd_anchor_map_1e13
receipts_needed.why: So claims about 'anchors' become verifiable data, not narrative.
receipts_needed.how: Deterministic script that takes the 1e13 receipt + optional primesieve raw output and emits an anchor map + merkle root.

receipts_needed.name: performance_receipt_matrix
receipts_needed.why: So runtime scaling claims are receipts, not extrapolation.
receipts_needed.how: Store (n, runner, primesieve_version, wall_time_seconds) as receipts for 1e9..1e14 on the same workflow.
